# @fungi.computer/workflows-wire

## Type Aliases

### WorkflowPublishedDefinitionContext

```ts
type WorkflowPublishedDefinitionContext = Pick<
  WorkflowPublicationContext,
  "installationId" | "git"
>;
```

The installation identity and Git access read from the Workflow publication
context.

---

### WorkflowPublishedReader

```ts
type WorkflowPublishedReader = Readonly<{
  published: Promise<Readonly<{
    definition: WorkflowDefinition;
    commit: string;
    version: number | null;
  }> | null>;
}>;
```

How a host reads one published Workflow definition back out of Git. The Trellis
App owns the Git layout (drafts, versions, the copy index); this port only wraps
that read into the braid-shaped `PublishedDefinition`.

---

```ts
type WorkflowRunListItem = z.output<typeof runListItemSchema>;
```

Decoded run row with its pinned publication and display metadata.

---

Calling member identity, or a refusal returned by the viewer read.

---

---

### WorkflowTriggerTarget


Published trigger, pinned commit, selected bindings and optional run delivery.

---

### WorkflowTriggerArmTarget

```ts
type WorkflowTriggerArmTarget = WorkflowTriggerTarget &
  Readonly<{
    digest: string;
  }>;
```

Host binding input carries the App-owned immutable row digest, never caller
input.

---

### WorkflowDraft

```ts
type WorkflowDraft = typeof workflowDraftSchema.Type;
```

One Workflow file's decoded content.

---

### WorkflowDocument

```ts
type WorkflowDocument = WorkflowDraft & object;
```

A Workflow file's content at the commit it was read from.

#### Type Declaration

| Name     | Type     | Description                                        |
| -------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `commit` | `string` | Exact Git commit from which the document was read. |

### WorkflowReadGit

```ts

```

Read-only Git operations needed to traverse and decode library files.

### workflowLibraryRepository

```ts
const workflowLibraryRepository: "trellis" = "trellis";
```

The read side of a Workflows library's Git layout, shared by the Workflows App
and the hosts that read its published definitions: one repository, `trellis`,
one `workflows/<id>.json` file per Workflow (its definition plus `layout` and
optional `provenance`), and one `<id>@v<n>` tag per published version on
`main`'s ancestry.

### inspectWorkflowFile()

```ts
function inspectWorkflowFile(
   git,
   workflowId,
   commit
): Promise<
  | {
  kind: "missing";
}
  | {
  kind: "valid";
  draft: {
     definition: {
        format: "fungi.workflow/v1";
        title: string;
        description?: string;
        apps: {
         [key: string]: object;
        };
        subgraphs?: {
         [key: string]: object;
        };
        triggers?: readonly (
           | {
           id: string;
           on: "webhook";
           title?: string;
           when?: Predicate;
           input?: {
            [key: ...]: ...;
           };
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           on: "schedule";
           title?: string;
           cron: {
              expression: string;
              timeZone: string;
           };
           input?: {
            [key: ...]: ...;
           };
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           on: "event";
           title?: string;
           app: string;
           event: string;
           eventDigest: string;
           when?: Predicate;
           input?: {
            [key: ...]: ...;
           };
           repository?: Mapping;
        })[];
        input: {
         [key: string]: Json;
        };
        nodes: readonly (
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "code";
           source: string;
           input: {
            [key: string]: Json;
           };
           output: {
            [key: string]: Json;
           };
           values: {
            [key: string]: Mapping;
           };
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "app";
           app: string;
           method: string;
           methodDigest: string;
           values: {
            [key: string]: Mapping;
           };
           gitAccess?:   | {
              binding: string;
              repository: string;
              branches: ...[];
            }
              | {
              binding: string;
              repository: string;
              access: "read";
            };
           retry?: {
              attempts: number;
           };
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "review";
           title: string;
           detail?: string;
           show: readonly object[];
           reviewers: "runner" | "owners";
           timeout: number;
           choices?: readonly object[];
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "condition";
           test: Predicate;
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "map";
           over: {
              node: string;
              port: string;
           };
           body: string;
           concurrency: number;
           maxItems: number;
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "repeat";
           body: string;
           maxRounds: number;
           until: Predicate;
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "wait";
           for: number;
         }
           | {
           id: string;
           kind: "transform";
           fields: {
            [key: string]: Mapping;
           };
        })[];
        edges: readonly object[];
        output: {
         [key: string]: object;
        };
     };
     layout: {
      [key: string]: object;
     };
     provenance?:   | {
        kind: "import";
        workflowId: string;
        version: number;
        commit: string;
        sha256: string & object;
        origin?: string;
      }
        | {
        kind: "fork";
        workflowId: string;
        commit: string;
      };
  };
}
  | {
  kind: "invalid";
  issues: readonly Issue[];
}>;
```

`Promise`\< \| \{ `kind`: `"missing"`; \} \| \{ `kind`: `"valid"`; `draft`: \{

`description?`: `string`; `apps`: \{ \[`key`: `string`\]: `object`; \};

### readPublishedWorkflow()

```ts
function readPublishedWorkflow(
  git,
  workflowId,
  at,
  copied?,
): Promise<(object & object & object) | null>;
```

One published Workflow: a version tag, or a commit, on `main`'s ancestry.
`copied` answers from a caller's own read copy of that commit when it has one;
otherwise the file is read from Git within a bounded read budget.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                            |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `git`        | `GitBinding`                                                    |
| `workflowId` | `string`                                                        |
| `at`         | \| \{ `version`: `number`; \} \| \{ `commit`: `string`; \}      |
| `copied`     | (`commit`) => [`WorkflowDocument`](#workflowdocument) \| `null` |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`object` & `object` & `object` \| `null`\>
